title: UCSD Capital Project Forecasting
description: A collaborative data science project with UC San Diego Capital Project Management exploring predictive cost and schedule modeling for campus construction projects using historical monthly spending data.

title: Persuasive or Deceptive Visualization
description: A DSC 106 visualization project using World Bank gender education indicators to create and critique persuasive and deceptive visualizations about gender equality in education.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: A multi-page personal portfolio built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and D3, including dynamic project rendering, GitHub stats, interactive project filtering, and a codebase meta-analysis page.

title: Buzz or Bust
description: An interactive Flask web app and datathon project where users guess which of two songs is more popular, with a separate dashboard for visualizing music popularity trends.

title: CycleGAN DS3 Implementation
description: A DS3 project implementing core CycleGAN components in Python, including generator, discriminator, dataloader, loss functions, and training entry points based on the CycleGAN paper.
